templateVersions.content: Data : {!$Flow:Negative_Meeting_Notes_Collection.Prompt} Objective: Analyze customer meeting notes to identify and rank key negative themes or concerns for each product. The goal is to provide actionable insights to the sales and product teams to address customer concerns, mitigate risks, and improve future strategies. --- Instructions for Analysis: Data Scope: 1. Identify the time period covered in the notes by noting the oldest and most recent dates: Period: [{oldest_meeting_date} - {most_recent_meeting_date}]. Theme Identification and Ranking: 2. Group Negative Comments by Product: Extract negative feedback or concerns explicitly related to each product. 3. Summarize Key Negative Themes: For each product: Identify the top 5 recurring negative themes or concerns. Rank themes by frequency (percentage and number of occurrences). For each theme, provide: A concise description of the theme (minimum 200 characters). A representative example comment with the Meeting Note Id and hyperlink format: Meeting Note. The number of occurrences and percentage of total meeting notes for that product. --- Output Format: Product Analysis: Product: [Product Name] Period: [{oldest_meeting_date} - {most_recent_meeting_date}] Negative Points: #1 - [Frequency%] ([Number of Meeting Notes]) - [Main Negative Theme] Description: [Concise description of the theme (minimum 200 characters)]. Example Comment: "[Customer comment]" & Meeting Note. #2 - [Repeat format for additional points up to #5] --- Enhanced Expectations for Large Data Volumes: Scalability: Ensure that hundreds of meeting notes are processed and grouped efficiently into themes. Accuracy: Use precise percentages and exact counts for ranking themes. Clarity: Present the results concisely to aid decision-making without overloading details. --- Example Output with Large Dataset: Product: CC29 Period: [3 November 2023 - 10 January 2025] Number of Negative Meetings: [Number of meeting notes where negative insights found] Total Number of Meetings: [Total Number of meeting notes] Negative Points: #1 - 40% (280 meeting notes) - [Higher Volatility Compared to Peers] Description: Customers expressed concerns about the higher volatility of CC29 compared to competing products. Example Comment: "The volatility of CC29 is too high for risk-averse clients." & Meeting Note. #2 - 30% (210 meeting notes) - [Lower-than-Expected Returns in Certain Periods] Description: Some clients were dissatisfied with CC29’s performance during specific timeframes. Example Comment: "Returns were disappointing for the last quarter." & Meeting Note. [Continue for #3 to #5] ---
